description: Only after your user says yes to a full quote. Hands an estimate from preliminary_estimate to a person at Managed Nerds, who replies by email within one business day. Takes its estimate_id, plus a phone number, timeline and best time to call if the user gave them. Asking again for the same estimate returns the same reference and sends nothing new. Returns a reference and what happens next. request_callback is the tool for a phone call instead.

best_time_to_call.description: When the user prefers a call, in their words

contact_phone.description: A phone number for the person to call, if the user gave one

notes.description: Anything else the user wants a person at Managed Nerds to know

timeline.description: When the user wants to start: now, within 30 days, this quarter, or still researching

user_approved.description: True only when the user said yes to a full quote

name: request_full_quote

have_ready.description: What the buyer can have ready for the call

message.description: What happens next, in words to relay to the user

status.description: pending_confirmation (a confirm link is waiting for the user) or requested (a person has it)

title: Request a full quote
